confirmedFindings.title: Unsent BYE to Transferor Leg on NOTIFY 200 OK
confirmedFindings.body: When the transfer target answers and NOTIFY 200 OK is received, the coordinator sets session state to COMPLETED but omits sending a BYE request to the transferor call leg, leaving the transferor channel connected and accumulating billing time.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Call this.sipServer.sendBye(session.transferorCallId) upon receiving successful NOTIFY 200 OK.
